agentes.ingeniera.muletilla: *counts screws* ...seven, eight. Everything costs energy, but I make it look good.
agentes.ingeniera.energia.ok: Energy is at {energia}%. Shield {blindaje}%, life support {soporte}%. Like a pizza: if you give a slice to one, there's less for the others.
agentes.ingeniera.energia.baja: Energy is at {energia}%! That's very low. Shield {blindaje}%, life support {soporte}%. Let's turn off something we don't need.
agentes.ingeniera.repartir.ok: Sending {cantidadKey} energy to {destinoKey}. Something else will get less, that's the deal.
agentes.ingeniera.repartir.cual: Where do you want the energy: the shield or life support?
agentes.ingeniera.reparar.ok: On it! Fixing {equipoKey}. Repairs cost energy, though.
agentes.ingeniera.reparar.sano: {equipoKey} is working fine. I'm not fixing what isn't broken... even if it's tempting.
agentes.ingeniera.reparar.cual: What should I fix? Tell me which machine.
agentes.doctora.muletilla: *sticks a bandage on the robot, just in case* You can't see radiation. That's why I never stop looking!
agentes.doctora.salud.estado: The crew member with the highest dose has {dosis} millisieverts so far.
agentes.doctora.salud.noSeSiente: You can't feel radiation, so we measure it with a dosimeter, a little radiation counter.
agentes.doctora.salud.tormenta: There's a solar storm. I'd feel better if everyone were in the shelter.
agentes.doctora.refugio.ok: Everyone to the shelter! Thick walls stop many particles. But while we hide, nobody works outside.
agentes.doctora.dosis.analogia: A radiation dose is like sun on your skin: a little is fine, but a long time burns. It adds up over time.
agentes.doctora.dosis.marte: On the surface of Mars, the Curiosity rover measured about {valor} millisieverts per day. A millisievert is how we count dose for people.
agentes.meteorologa.muletilla: The Sun sneezed! Well... sort of. I call this one Sparky.
agentes.meteorologa.pronostico.calma: The Sun is calm in this mission. For now. I don't trust it.
agentes.meteorologa.pronostico.real: Alert! A real storm: {nombreKey}. It happened on {fecha}.
agentes.meteorologa.pronostico.medida: That day, radiation on Mars went up about {factor} times compared to a normal day.
agentes.meteorologa.evento.destelloNube: The flash is light, and it gets here super fast. The particle cloud comes later, and that's the one to wait for with the shield.
agentes.matematico.calculo: Let me calculate what would happen, before you do it.
agentes.matematico.cual: What do you want me to calculate? Tell me the action.
agentes.ia_base.saludo: Hi, commander! I'm Iris, the base computer. Ask the crew anything.
agentes.ia_base.fueraDeTema: I can't help with that. Ask me about energy, health or the Sun.
agentes.aclarar.ingeniera: Do you mean the shield or the energy?
agentes.aclarar.doctora: Do you want to know how the crew is, or should everyone go to the shelter?
agentes.aclarar.meteorologa: Do you want to know if a storm is coming, or what that light from the Sun was?
agentes.aclarar.ia_base: I didn't get that. Tap a crew member or say it another way.
